Yes. Sun recorded **`tests fail`**.

- `F` means an assertion failed.
- `E` means a test raised an error.
- `.` means a test passed.

At least some errors come from tests calling `sun merge`, which the repo’s CLI no longer supports. The output is truncated, so it doesn’t show all failure details.
